impact: No change in system, but a different profile: Whitfield is a pure defender. Northgate's right flank no longer supports attacks (fewer overlaps), and Nakamura-Brooks wins far fewer duels. Kingsbridge stop targeting that side and shift their attacks to the right through El-Haddad.

impact: From 4-3-3 to 4-4-1: the wingers drop back to midfield, the line drops about 6 m and the high press is mostly abandoned. Lindqvist is isolated up front. Expected effect: possession falls from about 58% to about 45%, and Kingsbridge rely more on counters through Nakamura-Brooks.

reason: Kovač is tired and does little defensively; with 10 men the centre has to be closed.
impact: Same system, different balance: Achterberg sits in front of the defence, Visser moves to the left of midfield. The centre is tighter, but Kingsbridge lose their creator, so fewer key passes and even less possession. They now play to avoid losing rather than to win.

reason: Moreau is tired after an hour of defending; Northgate want more quality on the ball.
impact: Double substitution plus a switch from 4-4-2 to 4-3-3: three central midfielders against Kingsbridge's two, with Halvorsen in the pocket where Brannigan used to be. Northgate move from reacting to controlling; their press goes up and the line moves about 7 m higher.

reason: Petrov's hold-up play matters less now that Northgate have more of the ball; Diallo-Kerr brings pace against tiring legs.
impact: Part of the switch to 4-3-3: Diallo-Kerr plays on the right and attacks the space behind Mbeki.

chain_description: Duarte finds Halvorsen unmarked between the lines; his through ball sends Diallo-Kerr in behind Mbeki, and he finishes across Ferreira-Lind. 1-2.
significance: The result of the red card and both substitutions combined: Halvorsen receives the ball in exactly the zone a holding midfielder would normally cover. Four minutes after the tactical switch it pays off.

reason: Kingsbridge have to go for it. A wing-back with a better cross replaces the full-back.
impact: Switch to a back three with wing-backs and two strikers. Kingsbridge commit numbers forward: 4-5 players in the box on every cross. Downside: only three defenders against Northgate's three attackers, so every turnover is a potential counter.

reason: A target man for aerial balls; Visser is running on empty.
impact: Moore-Asante gives Kingsbridge a plan B: crosses. Expect the number of crosses and headed attempts to rise sharply.

reason: Adeyemi-Clarke has cramp; Northgate also want an extra centre-back against the aerial bombardment.
impact: From 4-3-3 to 5-4-1: Northgate choose the point. Okoro marks Moore-Asante, the line drops deep and the counter threat almost disappears (no fast striker left). Kingsbridge get the territory but face a packed box.
